name: dftracer_pipeline
description: Plan, route and run the full dftracer pipeline: session_run_pipeline (clone, detect, configure, build, smoke, annotate, pause for the annotation report, then install+compose dftracer, annotated build+run, split, analyze, diagnose), the pipeline_plan.md the planner writes (one '## STEP N: <executor-agent>' per stage, DISPATCH ORDER) and the deterministic plan/result validator. Load first for any full pipeline request or plan, when a step agent cannot find its plan section, 'Step N failed' from session_run_pipeline, 'Workspace not found for run_id', NameError smoke_cmd on resume, awaiting_confirmation, empty 0-byte traces, or dlio vs posix preset choice.
